name: Prolegomena: Oyoso 3 Funkan no Koushin no Saki ni Arawareru de Arou Kiwamete Choujigenteki na Interface no Tame no Joron
original_name: プロレゴメナ およそ3分間の交信の先に現れるであろうきわめて超次元的なインターフェースのための序論
source:
"This is a collaborative experiment between you and me. We have approximately three minutes for continuous interchanges. Let's repeat this limited time to examine transcendence of the interface."

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3358590/Prolegomena_To_a_Hyperdimensional_Interface_That_Will_Be_Able_to_Manifest_From_ThreeMinute_Interchanges/?curator_clanid=4777282]Steam[/url]]
translation:
「這是你與我共同進行的一場實驗。我們每次能夠連續通訊的時間約為三分鐘。讓我們反覆經歷這段有限的時間，探查介面的超越性。」
